svg.aria-label: Enterprise RAG assistant on Azure — hub-and-spoke landing zone
svg.title: Enterprise RAG assistant on Azure — hub-and-spoke landing zone
svg.desc: Employees chat with an assistant grounded on corporate documents. Traffic enters through Front Door, is governed by API Management, and reaches Azure OpenAI and AI Search over private endpoints. Documents are ingested asynchronously. Fictional example.

text.tspan: Entry point. Azure Front Door with WAF terminates
TLS and reaches API Management through Private Link,
so the backend has no public endpoint.
Governance. API Management validates the Microsoft
Entra ID token, applies rate limits and forwards the
Private data plane. The backend reaches Azure
OpenAI, AI Search and Cosmos DB through private
endpoints; public network access is disabled on all
Grounding. The backend retrieves the most relevant
chunks from the vector index and sends them with the
question to Azure OpenAI; the answer and its
citations are stored as chat history.
